content: Bepaŋdi me fofohidok momooŋ tiyemiŋa me kadakahi adi yehitubu-kadaka tibaak
Du me kadakahidi titiŋ dediŋ tiiŋ wendok nadibedi mu tibeŋ. Du me kadakaniŋ tiiŋ heki’walaŋ nemenemekhik doktiŋa hogok nadikadakafit mu tiluwaaŋ.
Nai muniniŋ-kabe hinek me hogohi adi kilihikitdi sigeneiŋ unduŋ, eŋ bem hapmuŋdi kumuŋa makwaneiŋ wendok tuwot kadakaneeŋ.
Du Yahwe hogok nadisukilitimiŋa titiŋ didimeniŋ hogok tibeŋ. Du unduŋ tiŋa helemahelemaŋ kwakeneŋ uŋoŋ kulemaŋgoŋ hatiŋa titiŋ didimeniŋ momooŋgoŋ keleeŋ tuluwaaŋ.
Du Yahwedok nadifo timimbune adibo welege gineŋ maŋgoŋdok hinek nadiluwaaŋ u kedem gamuluwaak.
Du hatihatige Yahwe kohoŋ foloŋ kameweŋ. Unduŋ tiŋa nadisukiliti hinek timimbune adi kedem gehitubu-lodawek.

Tiŋa titiŋge momooŋ u meledi hautalak unduŋ miŋgilaŋgoŋ tubuhautawaak. Tiŋa undugoŋ titiŋge momooŋ u mele lekiŋgoŋ folooŋ hinek hautalak wendok tuwolit metam namandahik foloŋ tubudakale-hinakaune kaneeŋ.

Du Yahwe hebeŋ foloŋ wo tubu-dulaaŋ kulemaŋgoŋ hatiŋa woomimbune adi kedem gehitubu-lodawek. Du me titiŋhik dediŋ tiŋa bomboŋ fee moŋgokiiŋ u yabuŋa nadigalika mu tibeŋ. Be me titiŋ hogohidok nadihebet tiŋa tubune mintaiŋ wendok nadibedi mu tibeŋ.
Du kwihita mu tiluwaaŋ, tiŋa welege bikabune kudup mu daluwaak. Titiŋ hogohi wendi gehimaneune kadakaniŋ tibaaneŋ ala, nemek hogohi undihidok welege yout adi mu tuluwaak.
Me hogohi adi yadi yehililiwene-kudapmaŋ tibaak. Eŋ metam nadisukiliti tiŋa Yahwedi yehitubu-lodadok woomiiŋ adi yadi kwehik kahileeŋ momooŋ hinek hatineeŋ.
Nai mu kweheyelune me hogohi adi liwe-dapmaŋ tineeŋ. Adi yabudok yohikwehineŋ diwewaaŋ iŋgoŋ nemu yabaaŋ.

Kaŋ metam nehi’walaŋ wohikgigitdok nadiune fofoŋnit tubune fofoŋnit hatineeŋ adi yadi Bepaŋdi kwet hogohogok u aditok yembaak. Kaŋ adi uŋoŋ kulema tubumintaaŋ iutumbaaŋ duhuduhunit hatiŋa nadifo tineeŋ.
Me hogoli adi me fofooŋ u tubukadaka titiŋdok nadilak. Unduŋ doktiŋa kaŋ kwihikwihileŋgoŋ nadilak.
Iŋgoŋ Wapum adi nai niŋ mintawaakneŋ uŋaniŋ me hogohi adi fidapmaŋ tineeŋ u agaŋ nadilak. Unduŋ doktiŋa Wapum adi yabuŋa gege tilak.
Me hogohi adi miknoŋhik wodibe labiiŋ, eŋ tebehithik yehimanekiŋgineeŋ me fiyewakahi be me fofoŋhinit u yalamkumune tiiŋ. Tiŋa undugoŋ metam titiŋ didimeniŋ tiiŋ u widihi-kumuŋ titiŋdok tiiŋ.
Iŋgoŋ oŋ, miknoŋhikdi udaneeŋ nehi’walaŋ kabahik uŋakoŋ youtombaak, eŋ tebehik hogohogok uligolodapmaŋ tineeŋ.
Me didimeniŋ hatilak’walaŋ bomboŋŋiŋ lufomgoŋ-kabe ilimiiŋ wondi me hogohi’walaŋ bomboŋhik mohok fee u yalakapme-dapmaŋ tilak.
Maŋgande, Yahwedi me hogohi’walaŋ saŋiniŋhik yolom-bedapmaŋ tibaak. Eŋ me didimehi hogok adi kedem yabudokooŋ yehi-ulihiwaak.
Metam welehik walaniŋ hinek adi yadi Yahwedi momooŋ hinek yabudokolak. Tiŋa kwet aditok yemilak woŋ adi aditok haliwooŋ halaak.
Nai kadakaniŋ gineŋ adi yadi malabumuŋ mu tubumintaneeŋ. Be fiye kadaka tiŋa map wapum mintawaak iŋgoŋ adi nanaŋedok baniŋ mu tineeŋ.
Iŋgoŋ me kadakahi adi kadaka-dapmaŋ tineeŋ. Eŋ Yahwe mik timiiŋ heki adi yadi wowoŋgimiŋdi mintaaŋ kotigoŋ kumuŋgolopmalak unduŋ tineeŋ, be mupmukdi nai muniniŋ-kabe looŋ liwelak unduŋ liweneeŋ.
Me kadakaniŋ adi nemek niŋ belak u kibikoŋ nemu tubu-udanelak. Iŋgoŋ me fofooŋ adi siloŋ momooŋ tiŋa metam nolidok nemek fee yemilak.
Metam Wapumdi yeniŋkahaŋ tilak adi yadi kwehineŋ momooŋ hinek hatineeŋ. Iŋgoŋ metam haki tiyemilak adi yadi yehikelekut tubune uneeŋ.
Yahwedi metam deŋandiŋ uuŋdok u yenindidimeeŋ yahaŋelak. Adi me niŋ’walaŋ titiŋŋiŋ kaŋ nadiune utumba binek tilak, woŋ adi didimeniŋ hatidok saŋiniŋ milak.
Me u maaŋ utak iŋgoŋ kadakadapmaŋ hinek mu tilak. Yahwedi kohoŋ foloŋ honeeŋ tubulodaaŋ hamaneune kotigoŋ pilali yatak.

Nu mekuyane gineŋ hatitalabubuyeŋ agaŋ gawada tilat, nai uŋaniŋ Bepaŋdi me didimeniŋ sigilulum nemu timimbune kagut. Be undugoŋ, me didimeniŋ’walaŋ wapmihiŋiyedi map tiŋa nanaŋedok nayo nemu tubune yabugut.
Helemahelemaŋ me didimeniŋ adi metam nolidok siloŋ tobogoŋ tiyemiŋa nemenemek fee yemilak. Kaŋ wapmihiŋiye yabuŋa nadiune u kahaŋ momooŋ niŋ tilak.
Unduŋ doktiŋa notne, du titiŋ kadakahi hogohogok u sigilulum tiyemiŋa titiŋ fofohi u hogok tiluwaaŋ. Unduŋ tiŋa kwetfoloŋ iŋoŋ hatiŋa wooŋ hatibaaŋ.

Bepaŋ adi titiŋ didimeniŋdok hogok nadilak. Adi yadi metamŋiye tuwot mu biyabune fitneeŋ. Yahwe adi helemahelemaŋ metam didimeniŋ hatiiŋ u hogok yabudokolak. Iŋgoŋ me hogohi’walaŋ wapmihihiye adi kadakadapmaŋ hinek tineeŋ.
Metam didimehi adi Bepaŋdi kwet yemguk u kahileneeŋ, tiŋa uŋgoŋ hatiŋa wooŋ hatineeŋ.
Me didimeniŋ adi nadinadiŋiŋ momooŋ doktiŋa mede kedehi hogok yolak. Tiŋa undugoŋ, titiŋ didimehidok hogok yolak.
Bepaŋ’walaŋ Yodoko Mededi weleŋ gineŋ hatak, unduŋ doktiŋa Bepaŋ takaliŋa Yodoko Mede u mu bikabulak.
Me hogoli adi kabup hebi-hali me didimeniŋ u dediŋ tiŋa ulukumumbit yoŋa hakakuwat tilak.
Iŋgoŋ Yahwedi me didimeniŋ u tuwot mu bikabune me hogolidi ulukumumbek. Be me hogolidi me didimeniŋ u mede gineŋ kamewek, iŋgoŋ Wapumdi me hogoli u nadimimbune mede gineŋ tuwot mu fafaŋewek.
Du Yahwe nadisukilitimiŋa adi’walaŋ titiŋ takaliweŋ. Unduŋ tibeŋ kaŋ nadigamuŋa kwet gamuŋa me loloŋnit gapmeune kahilewaaŋ. Unduŋ tiŋa yabune me kadakahi yehililiwene-kulaak.
Nu me kadakaniŋ kawene saŋiniŋŋiŋdi loloŋnit, Lebanon kwetneŋ uŋoŋ kweledi lohinakaaŋ bem noli yalakapme tiŋa yatak, wondok tuwolit tiŋa metam yalakapme-dapmaŋ hinek tuguk.
Kuŋgoŋ oŋ, kougoŋ mindaŋkade uŋandiŋ yauŋa kawene adiye kotigoŋ uŋoŋ mu hatilak. Kaŋ nobu kait yoŋa diweyaulat iŋgoŋ mu kalat.
Du me didimeniŋ kaweŋ, tiŋa me momooŋdi nemek kadakaniŋ nemu tuguk u kaŋ nadiweŋ. Me unduhi adi metam noli dut kulemaŋgoŋ hatiiŋ. Adi’walaŋ yalakiŋiye adi undugoŋ hatiŋa wooŋ hatiyaneeŋ.
Iŋgoŋ me kadakaniŋ tiiŋ heki yadi Wapumdi yehitubu-kadakadapmaŋ tilak. Eŋ yalakihiye adi liwedapmaŋ tineeŋ.
Yahwe negoŋ me didimehi u yehitubu-lodaaŋ kotigoŋ yahaŋelak. Malabumuŋ mintalak kaŋ negoŋ yabu-ulidokolak.
Yahwedi yehitubu-lodawek yoŋa adi’walaŋkade wiiŋ. Unduŋ doktiŋa adi yehitubu-lodaaŋ me hogohi kohohik gineniŋ kotigoŋ yehikagiyatak, kaŋ momooŋ hatiiŋ.
